basis: NHS England publishes its A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions statistics under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (stated in the statistical work-area page footer, quoted in the candidate record's license_evidence, read 2026-10-21). OGL v3 permits copying, publication, distribution, transmission and adaptation of the information with attribution, and expressly permits commercial use, so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, and our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0. The source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed: every copy of the data carries the OGL v3 attribution statement, and the dataset is labelled as derived, never as NHS England's official product.

third_party.permission: The benchmark checkout is read-only; permission to distribute verbatim copies of its runner files covers the distributed copies only

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the row selection, the derived month-over-month decline label, the temporal partition, the volume gate, the feature derivations and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying NHS England statistics keep their own designation and remain subject to OGL v3, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.
